name: single_role
note: one role, one entry, no subRole

name: multi_role
note: four roles inserted out of string order; role keys must sort as strings

name: sub_role_present_and_absent
note: subRole omitted when empty, present when set — `omitempty`

name: escaping_and_unicode
note: names with < > & and U+2028/U+2029 — Go escapes, serde_json does not (settled divergence: shape and round-trip fidelity, not bytes)

name: repeated_artists_in_role
note: the same artist twice in one role: the column stores both entries (duplicates live in the join table, ON CONFLICT dedupes there)

name: nil_participants
note: The production marshalParticipants shape starts with make(map[Role]...), so a nil model input stores `{}`; raw_direct separately records json.Marshal((model.Participants)(nil)) as `null`. Both unmarshal to an empty, non-nil map, so nil-vs-empty collapses through the column.
